description: Drop-in wrapper for the data-watch-page button. Renders an icon, compact, or full-button toggle (aria-pressed) that adds or removes the current page from the user's VBStore('watches') list. The state machine lives in src/utils/page-watch-init.js; the component repaints its label, icon and title from the button's aria-pressed.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual preset. icon is named by aria-label (data-label-action); compact and button are named by their visible text. Changing it after upgrade re-renders.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Constant visible text for the compact and button variants, used in both states (overrides data-label-watch / data-label-watching). Ignored by the icon variant.

attributes.name: server-sync
attributes.description: Turns on server-side sync via VBService('notify') for the whole page: sets the page-global window.vbPageWatch.serverSync flag, which every watch button (and the notification panel's unwatch) uses from then on. Equivalent to <meta name="vb-page-watch-server" content="true">.

attributes.name: data-label-watch
attributes.description: Visible text (and accessible name) of the compact/button variants while the page is not watched. Localisation hook.

attributes.name: data-label-watching
attributes.description: Visible text (and accessible name) of the compact/button variants while the page is watched. Localisation hook.

attributes.name: data-label-action
attributes.description: Icon variant: the button's aria-label, and its tooltip while not watched. Localisation hook.

attributes.name: data-label-stop
attributes.description: Icon variant: tooltip while the page is watched. Localisation hook.

events.name: page-watch:add
events.description: Bubbles from the inner button when the user starts watching

events.name: page-watch:remove
events.description: Bubbles from the inner button when the user stops watching (also dispatched by notification-wc's Watching tab)

structure.description: Generated toggle button with aria-pressed; icon variant carries aria-label, text variants a <span> label
